inputs.name: CodexAppServerAdapter.constructor.command
inputs.description: The base CLI executable and argument list used to construct the app-server command. When omitted, it defaults to { command: 'codex', args: [] }; the adapter appends 'app-server', '--stdio', '-c', and 'model_provider="openai"' to the arguments.

inputs.name: CodexAppServerAdapter.constructor.queue
inputs.description: An optional resource queue forwarded to codexTurn by run and generateImage. It defaults to undefined when omitted.

inputs.name: CodexAppServerAdapter.run.turn
inputs.description: The turn supplied for execution. The adapter passes it unchanged to codexTurn with the derived server command and optional queue.

inputs.name: CodexAppServerAdapter.generateImage.request
inputs.description: The image-generation request used to build the turn passed to codexTurn. The adapter appends an instruction to its prompt and sets the generated turn's effort to null, access to read-only, image to true, and onText to a no-op callback.

outputs.name: CodexAppServerAdapter.discover
outputs.description: The value returned by codexState for the configured base command and derived server command. The adapter returns that value without transformation.

outputs.name: CodexAppServerAdapter.run
outputs.description: An object containing text and model copied from codexTurn's result. The adapter returns no other fields from that result.

outputs.name: CodexAppServerAdapter.generateImage
outputs.description: Resolves to an object containing the decoded and validated image bytes and the revised prompt, or null when the completed image result has no revised prompt. The adapter only accepts a result whose image status is completed and which has no failure and a result payload.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown when codexTurn returns no image with completed status, no failure, and a result payload. Its message includes up to the last 600 characters of result text, or an image-generation availability hint when that text is empty.
